After a three-year hiatus, the 2026 Soul Train Awards are back to honor the best in R&B, Soul and Hip-Hop with special honorees , such as Elmiene , Durand Bernarr and Chaka Khan .

Watch on DirecTV

The 37th edition of the awards ceremony is hosted by Anthony Anderson, while categories include R&B/soul song of the year and Spotify’s RNB X International Artist.

How to Watch Soul Train Awards 2026 Live Online, at a Glance:

- Date: Nov. 27

- Network: CBS, BET, BET Her, VH1, MTV2, Logo

- Online Streaming: DirecTV , Philo , Fubo , Hulu + Live TV

When Does Soul Train Awards 2026 Start ?

The Soul Train Awards airs on Friday (Nov. 27), with a start time of 8 p.m. ET/PT. It was filmed at the Harris Theater in Chicago.

What TV Network Features Soul Train Awards 2026?

In 2026, the Soul Train Awards broadcasts on TV on CBS and BET, as well as BET Her, VH1, MTV2 and Logo.

Which Celebrities Are Performing During Soul Train Awards 2026?

The Soul Train Awards features a wide range of performances from top recording artists, including Durand Bernarr, Elmiene, Kirk Franklin, El DeBarge, Lucky Daye, Muni Long, Chaka Khan and others.

Where to Watch Soul Train Awards 2026 Online for Free
